extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance figures digitised: Figures 9, 10, 11 and 12. Characterisation figures and TPD/TPR/DRIFTS plots were skipped. Figure 10 uses separate left/right axes in panels a and d; values were assigned according to series colour/legend. Approximate values were read visually from the provided page images; very-low-conversion baseline points are especially uncertain.
